profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a full stack software engineer who has built and shipped web applications at companies of all sizes, from early-stage startups to large enterprises. I’m comfortable building across the stack, and lately I’ve been focused on integrating LLM-powered features into the products I work on.

I build mostly with TypeScript, React, and Next.js, with Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL on the backend. I also have experience with Go, Ruby on Rails, and AWS.

Before software engineering, I worked in higher education at a nonprofit centered on technology and social justice. My path into tech combined traditional and nontraditional education: UC Santa Cruz, The Everett Program, and Ada Developers Academy (Cohort 13).

Currently open to full stack, frontend, or backend roles.

positions.title: Founding Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- One of 4 engineers who transformed a coffee subscription platform from early prototype to production
- Built an LLM-powered email marketing service (OpenAI API, React Email)
- Owned features end to end, including the partner portal and inventory tracking system
- Early adopter of Claude Code and Conductor; helped establish team guidelines for using AI agents responsibly and efficiently
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Next.js · JavaScript · Prisma ORM · React · JavaScript Libraries · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · Microsoft Copilot · Docker · Jest · PostgreSQL · Node.js · OpenAI API · GraphQL · ChatGPT for Web Developers · Claude Code

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained web properties across 7+ e-commerce brands
- Architected a headless e-commerce site generator (Next.js, GraphQL, Shopify) to launch new revenue streams
- Replaced costly third-party plugins with custom AWS Lambda functions and scripts built on Shopify’s native features
- Owned the email marketing pipeline for 135K+ subscribers, building a reusable template library that sped up production and boosted weekly revenue
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Next.js · JavaScript · React · JavaScript Libraries · E-Commerce · Email Marketing · HTML · GraphQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Shopify · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · ChatGPT for Web Developers

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Regularly shipped changes to a high-traffic API as a backend engineer for Nordstrom's Checkout platform
- Shipped a Go address validation API that replaced scattered third-party calls and was adopted across the engineering org 
- Optimized DynamoDB data access on the Checkout API while keeping contracts stable for downstream services
- Wrote extensive unit and integration tests to support unifying in-store and online transactions onto a single API

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on a bot mitigation project for high-demand sneaker releases, using Redis and DynamoDb 
- Took active part in weekly Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily standups, retros, and backlog refinement

positions.title: Technology Director (Executive Fellow)
positions.description:
- Served as the organization’s technical lead, refining which technologies were in scope for ~150 student projects and running needs assessments with nonprofit and activist partners worldwide
- Gave students technical guidance throughout their year-long projects, from defining requirements and constraints to planning timelines for implementation
- Mentored younger cohorts of fellows as they developed their own technology curriculum and lesson plans
- Replaced outdated software with streamlined tools for project tracking, student progress, and 20 years of internal records
- Responsible for meeting the nonprofit’s technical needs, including managing the WordPress website, CiviCRM donor and alumni database, and hardware / software inventory

positions.title: Curriculum Developer (Everett Fellow)
positions.description:
- Independently designed and taught an intro to computing course for non-technical majors, built around hands-on Raspberry Pi projects; several lessons became staples of the organization’s core curriculum
- Adapted existing tech lab curriculum and taught classes of up to 15 undergraduates over several semesters
- Updated each new lab to reflect current technologies while keeping lessons accessible to students of all technical backgrounds

positions.title: Recruiting Intern
positions.description:
- Was the first intern on Google Fiber’s recruiting team
- Built an internal website to streamline the back-end hiring process
- Developed a hiring strategy for a first-of-its-kind full-time role within Alphabet
- Worked with teams across departments, iterating on both projects based on stakeholder and manager feedback
- Attended multiple skill-building workshops and talks led by IT industry leaders
positions.insights: Skills: Strategic Hiring · Recruiting · Web Design

positions.title: Writing Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutored first-year undergraduates working to satisfy the Entry Level Writing Requirement, many of them ESL learners
- Met one-on-one with students to work through major issues in their essays and strengthen their writing process
- Helped students build confidence as writers

educations.fieldOfStudy: Technology and Information Management with a Minor in Global Information and Social Enterprise

honors.title: Springboard Grant Award Recipient
honors.issuer: Issued by UCSC Office of Research · May 2019

honors.title: Session Speaker at the ICT4D Conference in Hyderabad, India

projects.title: CRM Development and Data Collection with the Indian National Hawker Federation
projects.description: I traveled to Bangalore, India to develop a constituent relationship management system for street vendors represented by the NHF. I worked alongside vendors and union organizers to collect data and digitize member records. I built the database with CIviCRM and integrated a messaging feature using Twilio SMS to allow for union-wide communication.

projects.title: Youth Empowerment Institute
projects.description: I co-led a summer camp aimed at empowering high school girls from nearby low-income communities to pursue careers in technology. In one week we taught our campers how to code in HTML/CSS and use JQuery Mobile to create a mobile app. I oversaw creating and teaching the coding lessons, managing relationships with our partners, and scheduling camp activities.
